lens: Computable checks, rule execution and evaluation
baseline_critique: Existing check_text.py enforces only declared literals and raw whitespace-token limits; default exit zero may include findings and none of the checks establishes usefulness.
edit_locally.py enforces exact source hash and span reconstruction but size of changes is not value, correctness or preservation of meaning.

The current smallest-set wording can be misread as inhibiting needed structural changes. Existing guidance already includes meaningful alternatives and reader edits, so credit these rather than claiming to invent them.
Local candidate exact-set agreement 18/36 versus original 21/36 did not improve; neither supplies semantic gold. Evidence quotations are not complete realization spans.

proposals.title: Execute a repair and compare the reader task
proposals.behavior: Name a reader failure and intervention; construct the actual candidate; compare original and candidate by attempting the same concrete reader task. Select the defensible result, including original if repair fails.
proposals.trigger: Material writing or improvement requested, scaled to authorization.
proposals.editing_improvement_effect: Makes an actual change such as moving a decision or explicating an inference and tests what becomes recoverable.
proposals.novelty_relative_to_baseline: structure-and-purpose already suggests removal or movement; adds a specified before/after reader task and permits coordinated restructuring instead of edit-size minimization.

model_code_author_roles.model: Generate and provisionally compare actual candidate.
model_code_author_roles.code: Optional exact reconstruction or separate comparison; cannot model real reader understanding.
model_code_author_roles.author: Provide intent or choose materially different directions when needed.

proposals.example: Move an existing decision memo recommendation earlier and test that both choice and condition are recoverable.
proposals.counterexample: Moving the insight to the start of a reflective essay may ruin its intended development.
proposals.evaluation_needed: Fresh varied tasks; blinded independent reader task, factual and author evaluation, time; compare against existing workflow.

proposals.title: Bind actual constraints to final artifact and retain semantic remainder
proposals.behavior: Map explicitly declared obligations to supported checks or contextual review; check final artifact after last edit, inspect enforcement status and hash; fix actual violations without imposing invented limits.
proposals.trigger: Explicit measurable constraint or high-stakes preservation obligation.
proposals.editing_improvement_effect: Make a candidate satisfy the actual brief while exposing unresolved meaning or scoping conflicts.
proposals.novelty_relative_to_baseline: Current guidance already checks explicit limits; adds a single obligation-to-final-receipt or semantic-remainder mapping and disallows generic pass claims.

model_code_author_roles.model: Translate only supported requirements and assess contextual remainder.
model_code_author_roles.code: Existing checker enforces literals, max words and max growth; emits hash and advisory findings. Automatic receipt linkage is proposed, not implemented.
model_code_author_roles.author: Resolve real conflicts or specify missing counted scope.

proposals.example: Check body-only literal and word ceiling, and separately review quotation attribution.
proposals.counterexample: An exact phrase present inside code or a quotation can satisfy raw-file counting without satisfying intended prose placement.
proposals.evaluation_needed: Test stale-artifact linkage, scope isolation, unsupported counter semantics and semantic false positives; no claim that checker judges quality.

proposals.title: Compare alternatives by gains and explicit losses
proposals.behavior: When an edit has a consequential tradeoff, create a few genuinely different alternatives including original; record intended gain and strongest specific loss; select for the actual task.
proposals.trigger: A keep/move/delete or local-versus-structural decision has material consequences.
proposals.editing_improvement_effect: Supports actual deletion, relocation, explanation or restructuring while preserving useful repetition and original contribution.
proposals.novelty_relative_to_baseline: Current guidance already tries local deletion; extends it with competing intervention levels, explicit loss and original as eligible outcome.

model_code_author_roles.model: Generate distinct alternatives and inspect each loss.
model_code_author_roles.code: Source-bound plan or comparison records edits; does not score novelty or merit.
model_code_author_roles.author: Decide meaningful preference conflicts or voice where uncertain.

proposals.example: Compare deleting a repeated prerequisite with keeping it at an independent entry point.
proposals.counterexample: A warning repeated before separate dangerous actions is valuable even if token duplication increases.
proposals.evaluation_needed: Fresh author-reviewed tasks; independent benefit, fidelity and burden, with no lexical-distance quality proxy.

proposals.title: Separate rule reliability, reader benefit, and issue-based stopping
proposals.behavior: Freeze rule trigger and counterexamples, retain independent decisions and unresolved states, inspect agreement and disagreement by label and target; separately evaluate baseline vs candidate on actual author and reader outcomes. Stop routine editing when requested issue and relevant checks are resolved and no named issue warrants another pass.
proposals.trigger: New semantic rule evaluation or completion decision for a real edit.
proposals.editing_improvement_effect: Provides a mechanism for rejecting nonworking rules and avoiding redundant rewrite loops while preserving targeted repairs.
proposals.novelty_relative_to_baseline: Calibration checked agreement and source binding; this adds a distinct task-benefit comparison and links further passes to an identified issue rather than a loop.

model_code_author_roles.model: Propose candidate, carry out edit, identify named remaining issues.
model_code_author_roles.code: Validate supported schema, anchors, hashes and bounds, never semantic correctness.
model_code_author_roles.author: Choose goal and accept or reject tradeoffs; independent readers and coders assess claims.

proposals.example: Compare procedural drafts on whether readers perform the actual task, while checking source conditions independently.
proposals.counterexample: Shared empty-label sets can yield high agreement while both coders miss a relationship.
proposals.evaluation_needed: Freeze task and selection; group documents, preserve unresolved cases and report independent outcomes and burden separately. No universal thresholds.

retire_or_change: Retire an implicit minimize-edits goal when a meaningful rewrite is authorized; select the intervention needed for the actual task.
Retire generic all-checks-passed claims that conceal unavailable checks or semantic obligations.
Retire automatic repetition of polish/review cycles without a named issue.
Do not require full semantic annotation or show process bureaucracy for ordinary edits.
nonnegotiable_distinctions: Preserve accepted F01-F09 and Family → Form → Section; measured ranges, working targets and actual limits remain separate.
Mechanically valid, factually faithful, author-accepted and useful are distinct outcomes; no universal quality or novelty score.
Original contribution and necessary technical terms are not replaceable by generic novelty, literal preservation or conformity to a median.
Empty, missing and unresolved annotations differ; source labels and units, targets, boundaries and proposed mappings remain distinct.
Unknown author intent should not be invented and a model self-comparison does not establish independent reader benefit.
questions_for_peers: What would demonstrate that a broader restructure serves the author rather than merely changing surface shape?
Which conditions trigger competing alternatives without imposing noticeable burden on simple work?
Can the constraint receipt remain auditable when the final response is chat rather than a saved file?
What smallest independent reader task could distinguish a genuine gain from a superficially persuasive rationale?
